title: AiBatchItem
description: ai.batch-item@1: one prompt of a batch on OpenVibe.AI (POST /api/v1/batches). The item is the queue and the status of that one prompt: it waits for capacity (or for a provider's own batch API), runs, and carries the answer, the run it made and the money. A prompt that reached its deadline without capacity expires and is never charged.

idx.description: The item's place in the batch.

status.description: queued (asked for, not started), waiting (no cheap capacity yet), running (a provider works on it), succeeded, failed, expired (the deadline passed; not charged), cancelled (the batch was cancelled).

model.description: The model the item asked for, or the batch's own.

run_id.description: The run the item made, when it made one.

answer.description: The answer the provider gave, as text.

reason.description: Why the item ended without an answer (it expired, it was cancelled).

capacity.description: Where the answer came from: a community offer, the regular capacity, or a provider's own batch API.

cost_nano_usd.description: What the answer really cost, in nano-USD (1 USD = 1e9 nano), as a string: the money is never a float.

absorbed_nano_usd.description: What the network absorbed (the route cost more than the customer paid), in nano-USD, as a string.

charged_nano_usd.description: What the customer was charged, in nano-USD, as a string: half the retail card.
